title: KiCad in the Browser
claim: Show HN: KiCad in the Browser
why_good: By enabling PCB design directly in the browser, it lowers the barrier to entry for hobbyists and educators, fostering a new generation of electronics enthusiasts.
value: Monetization could come from subscription plans for advanced features, as well as partnerships with PCB manufacturers for streamlined production services.
risk: The project may struggle to scale if larger, established PCB design tools integrate similar browser capabilities, overshadowing its unique offering.
